prediction_ref.short_label: Frontier-class open-weight LLM runs single-node under 256GB by Q4 2026

validation_rows.evidence_summary: vLLM v0.24.0's Model Runner V2 now supports quantized models by default and adds a multi-tier KV-cache offloading path that spills cache to an object-store secondary tier beyond GPU memory, alongside a 180-290% SM90 CUTLASS FP8 kernel speedup. These are exactly the serving-layer levers — low-precision-by-default weights plus offloading the KV footprint out of scarce GPU memory — that make running a heavy open-weight checkpoint on a single high-memory node tractable rather than a multi-GPU-cluster job. The release moves quantized loading and tiered KV spill from opt-in tuning to documented defaults in the dominant open-source server, lowering the memory floor for single-node deployment of frontier-class open weights. It does not by itself demonstrate a specific 700B-plus model fitting under 256GB with published independently-reproduced accuracy retention, so it is enabling infrastructure for the prediction rather than direct fulfillment.

validation_rows.evidence_summary: The WorldEvolver arXiv paper proposes inference-time self-evolving world models that sharpen LLM-agent action-outcome prediction via episodic memory, semantic rules distilled from prediction errors, and selective foresight that filters unreliable predictions before the planner acts. This targets the same agent-harness reliability surface the trifecta-gate prediction lives on, and NVIDIA's Secure Agent Workspace reference design (shipped with today's Foundry GA) shows the orchestration-layer security framing is being productized around autonomous agents. But the prediction's load-bearing claim is a default-on capability gate that caps the lethal trifecta (private-data access, untrusted content, external communication), a deny-by-default authorization control — a different mechanism from WorldEvolver's prediction-quality filtering, which improves what an agent does rather than constraining what it is permitted to combine. The relevance is thematic (agent reliability at the harness layer) rather than direct evidence for the gating mechanism.
